content.text: The available data consists only of zone air-temperature sensors and heating/cooling setpoints. Zone F3Z01's sensor rose ~2.0 °C after July 2018 (23.08 → 25.10) while its setpoints stayed flat, and other zones rose only ~0.4–0.8 °C. That differential is consistent with both a local load increase (real warming) and a sensor fault (apparent warming), and with only zone-temperature sensors + setpoints there is nothing independent to confirm which.

input.needed_streams: An independent indication of the zone's actual thermal state or load to distinguish a real temperature change from a sensor fault, e.g. supply/return (delivered) air temperature to the zone, the zone's cooling/heating energy or airflow, or a second/redundant temperature sensor; occupancy/interior-load data would also help establish a local load change.
